faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Do my customers need to install an app?
faq.a1: No. Your store is a web page that opens in any phone browser. The order is sent through the WhatsApp or Telegram app they already have.
faq.a2: When a customer checks out, the order is saved and opens as a ready-made message to your WhatsApp number or Telegram account. Every order also appears on your order board.
faq.q3: Do you take a cut of my sales?
faq.a3: No. Customers pay you directly — cash, card on delivery or bank transfer. Flami never handles the money.
faq.q4: Can I use my own currency and time zone?
faq.a4: Yes. Choose them when you create your store, and change them later in settings.
faq.q5: Can I change my menu later?
faq.a5: Anytime. Edits show on your store right away, including marking a dish as sold out for the day.
faq.q6: What happens when I am closed?
faq.a6: Customers can still browse your menu and see when you open next, but they cannot place an order.
faq.q7: Do I need to be good with technology?
faq.a7: No. Add your menu from a photo, share your link, and orders arrive in the chat you already use.
faq.q8: What if a customer doesn't send the message?
faq.a8: The order is saved the moment they check out. It shows on your order board, and your phone gets a notification if you turn them on.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: What data Flami collects, why, who processes it and how to delete it.
privacy.intro: Flami (flami.org) lets food businesses take orders online. Each store is an independent business. For orders, the store decides how customer data is used, and Flami processes it on the store's behalf. This page explains what we collect and why.

sections.title: What customers give when ordering
sections.body: Name, phone number, and when the store asks for it, email. For delivery: address, landmark and, if you tap "Use my current location", your coordinates. Also the order itself, your note, the payment method and, for bank transfers, the receipt photo you upload. If you leave a review, your rating and comment are stored, and only your first name is shown publicly.

sections.title: What store owners give
sections.body: Email, password (stored only as a one-way hash), store details, menu and settings.

sections.title: What is kept in your browser
sections.body: Your cart, your last order (to show "Track your order"), your name and phone for the next checkout, and display choices. This stays on your device. We use cookies only to keep owners signed in, remember the language and the admin menu layout. Flami itself uses no advertising cookies.

sections.title: Why we use the data
sections.body: To deliver the order to the store, show its status, let the store contact you, prevent abuse (IP addresses are hashed before use in rate limits) and fix errors. We do not sell personal data and do not handle card payments.

sections.title: Who processes it
sections.body: Vercel (hosting), Supabase (database and files, servers in Japan), Sentry (error reports, with phone numbers and emails removed), OpenStreetMap Nominatim (turns coordinates into an address), and OpenAI (only menu photos an owner uploads to import a menu). The order message is sent by you through your own Telegram or WhatsApp app. If a store turns on Meta Pixel, anonymous page and order events (no names or phone numbers) go to Meta for that store's ads.

sections.title: How long and your rights
sections.body: Orders are kept while the store has its account. You can ask for a copy of your data, a correction or deletion. Ask the store, or ask us and we will pass it on.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaDescription: The rules for using Flami as a store owner and as a customer.
terms.intro: These terms apply to everyone who uses Flami (flami.org): store owners who run a store on it and customers who order from those stores.

sections.title: What Flami is
sections.body: Flami gives a store an online menu, a checkout and an order board. The sale is between the store and the customer. Flami is not the seller and does not cook, deliver or take payments.

sections.title: Store owners
sections.body: You are responsible for your menu, prices, food quality and safety, delivery, refunds, the payments you receive and following the laws that apply to your business, including how you use your customers' data. Keep your password safe. You may not sell illegal goods, send spam or use Flami to deceive people.

sections.title: Plans and payment
sections.body: The Free plan never limits incoming orders. Pro adds tools for a monthly or yearly fee, paid to us directly. Pro ends at the end of the paid period unless it is renewed, and your data stays. Prices may change. We will tell you before a change affects you, and the founding-store price is kept as promised.

sections.title: Customers
sections.body: Prices, availability and delivery times come from the store. Questions about an order, payment or refund go to the store. Please give correct contact details and don't place fake orders.

sections.title: Our service
sections.body: We work to keep Flami available and correct, but it is provided as is. We may change features, and we may suspend a store that breaks these terms or the law. To the extent the law allows, Flami is not liable for losses from a store's goods or service, or from interruptions of the service.

sections.title: Changes
sections.body: We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version. If you keep using Flami after a change, you accept the new terms.
